overview: TradeNest Naturals supplies dehydrated spinach leaf powder produced from carefully selected Indian spinach leaves. Processed through a six-step manufacturing sequence, the leaves are cleaned, sorted, dehydrated under controlled conditions, and ground to an 80 mesh powder. This free-flowing green ingredient offers a characteristic vegetal taste and uniform particle consistency, removing the handling, perishability, and preparation challenges of fresh leaves.

As an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter, we support food manufacturers, commercial kitchens, and private-label brands. The powder contains no added salt, sugar, or synthetic colorants. With standard bulk supply starting at an MOQ of 5 kg, we offer custom particle sizes, flexible packaging options, complete export documentation support, and pre-shipment product samples on request.
highlights: Refined 80 mesh particle size for uniform dry blending
Moisture content controlled at or below 7 percent
Characteristic spinach flavor with natural green appearance
Free-flowing powder without added salt, sugar, or synthetic colors
Extended 12-month shelf life under recommended dry storage
Single-ingredient dehydrated spinach leaf powder of Indian origin
applications: Instant soup mixes, broths, and gravy bases
Savory snack seasonings and extruded namkeen coatings
Bakery items including savory biscuits, crackers, and flatbreads
Ready-to-cook meals and dehydrated vegetable premixes
Dry beverage blends and culinary smoothie formulations
Dips, dressings, sauces, and savory fillings
Foodservice recipes for restaurants, caterers, and cloud kitchens
packaging: 25 kg bags and durable HDPE containers
5 kg to 10 kg food-grade intermediate bags
Retail-ready PET jars and tamper-evident containers

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for bulk spinach leaf powder?
faqs.a: The minimum order quantity starts at 5 kg, accommodating both product trial runs and commercial bulk orders.

faqs.q: Can you customize the mesh size and particle consistency?
faqs.a: Yes. While 80 mesh is our standard specification, alternative particle sizes can be produced upon request to match your technical requirements.

faqs.q: What packaging formats are available for bulk and private-label orders?
faqs.a: We offer 25 kg bags, HDPE containers, 5 kg to 10 kg intermediate bags, as well as small private-label pouches and jars.

faqs.q: Do you provide product samples prior to order placement?
faqs.a: Yes. Product samples are available on request to assist with factory recipe trials, process validation, and quality assessment.

faqs.q: What manufacturing process is followed for this powder?
faqs.a: We utilize a dedicated six-step process comprising sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and packing with dispatch.

faqs.q: What compliance and export documentation do you provide?
faqs.a: As an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter, TradeNest Naturals provides complete export documentation support, batch records, and detailed product specification sheets.
